Is there a type of reader right now that i can change what i'm looking at, and is there a way to go back and forwards in the navigation made?

A face isnt that helpful is it, the reader needs a way to see the actual location you are looking at and to be able to update it?

Well, I do need this level of things. Or I'm not going to be able to navigate properly.
body.title: Seeing where you are
